figurative_meaning_en: The onset of happiness or prosperity before the expected time
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমার জীবনে হঠাৎ অকালবসন্ত এসেছে, লটারিতে জিতে গেছি।
দুর্ভাগ্যের মধ্যে তার জন্য অকালবসন্ত হলো চাকরির অফার।
example_sentences_in_english: An untimely spring has suddenly arrived in my life; I won the lottery.
In the midst of misfortune, the job offer was an untimely spring for him.
note: This idiom draws from Bengal's seasonal cycles, evoking rural imagery of spring arriving unexpectedly.
